definitions.name: W3B.SUM
definitions.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: W3B.MEAN
definitions.body: 'SX' BIND SX W3B.SUM SX LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: mean of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: W3B.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

definitions.name: W3B.MAXOF
definitions.body: SORT REVERSE 0 GET
definitions.note: largest number of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: W3B.PAIRS
definitions.body: 'PR' BIND PR KEYS PR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Record -> Vector of [ key value ] pairs

definitions.name: W3B.TOPPAIR
definitions.body: 'TP' BIND TP [ 1 GET ] MAP W3B.MAXOF 'TM' BIND TP [ 1 GET TM EQ ] FILTER 0 GET 0 GET
definitions.note: Vector of [ key number ] pairs -> key of the first pair with the largest number

definitions.name: W3B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: TALLY W3B.PAIRS W3B.TOPPAIR
definitions.note: most frequent element of a Vector, earliest first occurrence on ties

definitions.name: W3B.JOINSP
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: W3B.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER 'CW' BIND CW CHARS 0 GET UPPER CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper, rest lower

definitions.name: W3B.LW
definitions.body: LOWER W3B.WORDS
definitions.note: String -> Vector of its lower-case words

definitions.name: W3B.SGN
definitions.body: 'DC' BIND 1 -1 DC '(' EQ NOT DC '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT
definitions.note: bracket character -> 1 if opening, -1 if closing

definitions.name: W3B.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ W3B.SGN ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: greatest nesting depth of a bracket String

definitions.name: W3B.RED1
definitions.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: one pass deleting adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: W3B.REDUCE
definitions.body: W3B.RED1 W3B.RED1 W3B.RED1 W3B.RED1 W3B.RED1 W3B.RED1
definitions.note: bracket String of at most 12 chars with all matched pairs deleted

definitions.name: W3B.BAL
definitions.body: W3B.REDUCE '' EQ
definitions.note: TRUE when a bracket String is balanced

definitions.name: W3B.UNMATCHED
definitions.body: W3B.REDUCE CHARS LENGTH
definitions.note: characters left after deleting matched pairs

definitions.name: W3B.BPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS 'PV' BIND 0 PV LENGTH RANGE [ 'PK' BIND PK 0 PV PK TAKE JOIN W3B.BAL SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

definitions.name: W3B.NAMES
definitions.body: [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> names

definitions.name: W3B.AMTS
definitions.body: [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> amounts

definitions.name: W3B.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE W3B.NAMES LE W3B.AMTS GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ W3B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: entries -> Record name -> sum of amounts, first-appearance order

definitions.name: W3B.LARGEST
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE W3B.AMTS W3B.MAXOF 'LM' BIND LE [ 1 GET LM EQ ] FILTER 0 GET
definitions.note: entry with the largest amount, first on ties

definitions.name: W3B.LONGEST
definitions.body: W3B.WORDS 'LW' BIND LW LW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 2 COLLECT ZIP W3B.TOPPAIR
definitions.note: longest word of a String, first on ties

definitions.name: W3B.CHFLAGS
definitions.body: 'CV' BIND CV 0 GET 1 SUB 1 COLLECT CV -1 DROP CONCAT 'CP' BIND CV CP SUB 'CD' BIND CD CD MUL 0 GT
definitions.note: Vector -> booleans, TRUE where a new run of equal values starts

definitions.name: W3B.FSTARTS
definitions.body: 'FF' BIND 0 FF LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE FF 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: boolean flag Vector -> indices of the TRUE flags

definitions.name: W3B.FLAGLENS
definitions.body: 'FL' BIND FL W3B.FSTARTS 'FS' BIND FS 1 DROP FL LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT FS SUB
definitions.note: run-start flags -> length of each run

definitions.name: W3B.DEDUPE
definitions.body: 'DV' BIND DV DV W3B.CHFLAGS W3B.FSTARTS GET
definitions.note: collapse runs of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: W3B.RLE
definitions.body: 'EV' BIND EV W3B.DEDUPE EV W3B.CHFLAGS W3B.FLAGLENS 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: run-length encoding as [ value count ] pairs

definitions.name: W3B.UPFLAGS
definitions.body: 'UV' BIND UV 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT UV -1 DROP CONCAT 'UP' BIND UV UP SUB 0 GT NOT
definitions.note: Vector -> booleans, TRUE where a strictly increasing stretch starts

definitions.name: W3B.MAJ
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV TALLY W3B.PAIRS 'MP' BIND MP W3B.TOPPAIR NIL MP [ 1 GET ] MAP W3B.MAXOF 2 MUL MV LENGTH GT SELECT
definitions.note: value in more than half of the positions, else NIL

definitions.name: W3B.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: keep the non-NIL elements

definitions.name: W3B.PICK
definitions.body: 'PE' BIND 'PA' BIND PA PE PE NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: acc elem -> elem, or acc when elem is NIL

definitions.name: W3B.FILLED
definitions.body: 'FV' BIND FV FV W3B.PRESENT 0 GET [ W3B.PICK ] SCAN
definitions.note: forward-fill NIL readings, leading ones take the first present reading

definitions.name: W3B.MISS01
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 'MB' BIND 1 0 MB SELECT
definitions.note: Vector -> 1 where NIL, else 0

definitions.name: W3B.GAPCOUNT
definitions.body: W3B.MISS01 'GM' BIND 0 1 COLLECT GM -1 DROP CONCAT 'GP' BIND GM GP SUB 0 GT 'GS' BIND 1 0 GS SELECT W3B.SUM
definitions.note: number of runs of consecutive NIL readings

definitions.name: W3B.RUNSTEP
definitions.body: 'RE' BIND 1 ADD RE MUL
definitions.note: acc flag -> acc+1 when flag is 1, else 0

definitions.name: W3B.LONGGAP
definitions.body: W3B.MISS01 0 [ W3B.RUNSTEP ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest run of NIL readings

definitions.name: W3B.NZ0
definitions.body: 'NX' BIND 0 NX NX NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: NIL -> 0, a number stays

definitions.name: W3B.RAT2
definitions.body: 'RY' BIND 'RX' BIND RX W3B.NZ0 RY W3B.NZ0 DIV NIL RX NIL? NOT RY NIL? NOT AND SELECT
definitions.note: x y -> x/y, or NIL when either is NIL

definitions.name: W3B.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND 0 RV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'RI' BIND RV RI GET RV RI 1 SUB GET W3B.RAT2 ] MAP 1 DROP
definitions.note: each reading divided by the one before it, NIL where either is missing

definitions.name: W3B.SCALED
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV W3B.PRESENT W3B.MAXOF 'SM' BIND SV [ SM W3B.RAT2 ] MAP
definitions.note: present readings divided by the largest present one, NIL stays NIL

definitions.name: W3B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: W3B.ABS
definitions.body: 'AX' BIND AX AX -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: absolute value, lifts over Vectors

definitions.name: W3B.MAD
definitions.body: 'MD' BIND MD MD W3B.MEDIAN SUB W3B.ABS W3B.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation

definitions.name: W3B.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'MV3' BIND MV3 -2 DROP MV3 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MV3 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

definitions.name: W3B.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'RM' BIND RM RM 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum

definitions.name: W3B.MODE
definitions.body: TALLY W3B.PAIRS 'MP' BIND MP [ 1 GET ] MAP W3B.MAXOF 'MC' BIND MP [ 1 GET MC EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP SORT 0 GET
definitions.note: most frequent number, smallest on ties

definitions.name: W3B.TRIMMED
definitions.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP W3B.MEAN
definitions.note: mean after removing one smallest and one largest
